From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: FintechX inference discovery + next steps

Jordan — thanks for the time earlier today. Great conversation — I've captured a short recap and proposed next steps below. Attaching a short overview of our Dedicated offering and a mutual action plan (MAP) for the pilot.

Summary from our call:
- Current state: on-prem + cloud hybrid for training, inference currently hosted in GCP with k8s autoscaling. Peak burst qps ~1.2k at end-of-day settlements; tail p95/p99 latency for fraud model occasionally spikes >150ms.
- Pain points: unpredictable burst costs, difficulty hitting p99 latency during spikes, and a tight audit/compliance window for customer data (need SOC2 evidence + encryption at rest).
- Priority: Reduce per-call cost by ~30% and reach consistent p99 <100ms. Pilot timeline: evaluate options over next 6-10 weeks if feasible.

Redwood fit / immediate suggestions:
- Dedicated GPU pools (reserved capacity) for steady throughput with burst capacity for peak windows.
- Inference runtime optimizations: KV-cache reuse and continuous batching to reduce per-token cost without increasing median latency.
- Quantization profiles for the current model family to reduce memory pressure and improve throughput on T4/A10s.
- Private deployment option if you need VPC/on-prem for regulated data.

Attachments included:
- redwood-dedicated-overview.pdf (1-page capabilities + sizing guidance)
- mutual-action-plan-FintechX.xlsx (draft MAP with milestones: security review, pilot config, PO/Eval)
- security-soc2-evidence.pdf (SOC 2 artifact list + where to find supporting docs)

Proposed next actions:
1) You: confirm priority and internal stakeholders for procurement/security (target by EOW 5/14).
2) Us (Redwood): provide a confident pilot SOW and a rough cost estimate for a 4-week dedicated pilot (by 5/12).
3) Joint: schedule a 30-minute tech session with David (SE) to walk infra requirements and pilot config.

If any of the summary points above are off, tell me and I'll update. Otherwise, if you can confirm the stakeholders and priority, I'll circulate the MAP and an initial SOW draft.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing if we can help.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Checking in — FintechX MAP and pilot timeline

Hi Jordan — just circling back on the MAP and pilot timeline I sent last week. Wanted to check whether this is still a priority for FintechX over the next 6-10 weeks and whether procurement/security stakeholders have the bandwidth to review the attached docs.

Quick ask: can you confirm one of the following options?
- Green: proceed with pilot (we'll send SOW + tech-session times this week)
- Delay: not a priority right now — we can pause and I'll follow up in 4-36 weeks
- Need more info: tell me what additional materials you need (cost breakdown, benchmarks, SOC2 artifacts, etc.)

If it's helpful I'm happy to set a 20-minute call this week to walk the MAP and answer any security questions live — David can join for technical details.

Thanks — if you're swamped, a quick reply with one word (Green / Delay / More) is totally fine and I'll take it from there.

Best,
Camila
